signature.name: Intramuros
signature.detail: The walled old town is Manila's historic heart, with cobblestone streets and Spanish-era architecture. Go early in the morning to avoid the heat and crowds; enter via the gates near Rizal Park.

signature.name: Fort Santiago
signature.detail: This citadel inside Intramuros offers a moat, gardens and the Rizal Shrine. Visit before 10am for cooler weather; tickets are inexpensive and can be bought at the gate.

signature.name: San Agustin Church
signature.detail: A UNESCO-listed baroque church and the oldest stone church in the Philippines. Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) and visit outside mass times for quiet viewing.

signature.name: Rizal Park
signature.detail: A large urban park honoring national hero José Rizal, with gardens and monuments. Best visited in the late afternoon when locals gather; it's a short walk from Intramuros.

transport: Jeepney or bus ride under $0.50; Grab taxi $3-5 for short trips
